default/30929.htm.text: Antique Dealer Patrin: It's nice to meet you, young traveler! My name is Patrin. I am a dealer of antiques. I've become quite busy lately due to the many excavations going on in the Ruins, the Tower of Insolence and the Garden of Eva. Adventurers are constantly coming to me for appraisals...

Q00355_FamilyHonor/30929-01.html.text: Antique Dealer Patrin: Yes, Trader Galibredo told me about you. He said that you would be stopping by with some antique statues to be appraised... Oh my! That statue... is that the "Lady of the Court" by Berona? Where did you find such a precious item...? Let me have a look!

Q00371_ShrieksOfGhosts/30929-01.html.text: Antique Dealer Patrin: It has come to my attention that the Orc seer Reva of the Town of Aden is collecting Ancient Ash Urns. I asked him to give them to me so that I could sell them for a handsome price to antique collectors. He refused my offer, insisting that he needed them for a ritual! He prom…

Q00372_LegacyOfInsolence/30929-02.html.text: Antique Dealer Patrin: Wow! Is this an ancient epic? What a find! I'll take it! I can pay you this much. If you find any more ancient epics, please bring them all to me. I will appraise them and give you the best possible prices.

Q00372_LegacyOfInsolence/30929-01.html.text: Antique Dealer Patrin: There's a rumor that you've been collecting old scrolls at the Tower of Insolence... Have you come across a scroll of ancient epic, written by a troubadour from the ancient era? If you have such an item, it could be of great value. Artistic value is quite subjective. It may l…

Q00355_FamilyHonor/30929-05.html.text: Antique Dealer Patrin: Just a moment... Let me get my reading glasses... Now, what have we here? Hmm...?! Oh... Heh heh...! This is no work of Berona. It is a very cleverly made imitation ! An apprentice sculptor must have copied the work of Berona. It is not worth much.

Q00355_FamilyHonor/30929-06.html.text: Antique Dealer Patrin: Just a moment... Let me get my reading glasses... Now, shall I take a look at it? Hmm... Oh Oh...! Hmm...?! Heh Heh...! This is not Berona's work! It's a forgery ! It must have been made by a skillful counterfeiter! I am sorry. It is virtually worthless.

Q00355_FamilyHonor/30929-07.html.text: Antique Dealer Patrin: Just a moment... Let me get my reading glasses... Now, what have we here? Hmm... Huh...?!! I barely touched it! How could I have made such a mistake! May I offer my abject apologies! Ancient articles such as this are so very fragile!

Q00355_FamilyHonor/30929-08.html.text: Antique Dealer Patrin: Why would you come to me empty-handed and ask for an appraisal? Are you kidding? What insolence!

Q00371_ShrieksOfGhosts/30929-02.html.text: Antique Dealer Patrin: An appraisal determines the true value of an item! To the untrained eye, an antique piece like this one may seem rather ordinary. But to the experienced eye of an expert like myself, each subtle mark and worn surface tells a story. The materials and techniques used to create …

Q00371_ShrieksOfGhosts/30929-03.html.text: Antique Dealer Patrin: What's the big idea, coming to me empty-handed for an appraisal? Are you crazy or is this some kind of a joke?

Q00371_ShrieksOfGhosts/30929-04.html.text: Antique Dealer Patrin: Just a moment... Let me get my glasses... Now, what have we here, hmm? Oh, my! Indeed! This is a famous porcelain , made by the court sculptors! It is of the highest quality. It will fetch a great price at any store!

Q00371_ShrieksOfGhosts/30929-05.html.text: Antique Dealer Patrin: Just a moment... Let me get my glasses... What have we here, hmm? Hmm... Oh my! Indeed! You've found a high grade porcelain. It has been glazed to make it shiny. Most likely it decorated the home of an Elmoreden aristocrat... It will fetch a good price at any store.

Q00371_ShrieksOfGhosts/30929-06.html.text: Antique Dealer Patrin: Just a moment... Let me get my glasses... Now, what have we here, hmm? Oh Oh...! Well, there's no go way to say this... This is a low grade porcelain. Take a look here... Do you see this scratch? And look at this chipped edge... I'm sorry. It won't fetch much at a store.
